set.body: Add explicit DraftOrigin.NewFamily (nominal family id, name, admitted dataset, seed recipe/studio fields), no synthetic saved base. Keep one project-wide draft and NoChanges for existing-origin edits. Provisional family exists only in the origin until SaveAndRun atomically materializes family/ownership; discarding it returns to the prior exact representation. Add conditional document/science/journal rungs after b2, never extend an already-landed wire version silently. Commands, edit/revert, discard/restore, save, undo/redo, recovery and refusals preserve immutable saved facts; global revision IDs allocated independently of family.
set.title: S7.7b3 Independent seeded family draft lifecycle
